title: Never Hike Alone: A Friday the 13th Fan Film
original_title: Never Hike Alone: A Friday the 13th Fan Film
overview: An adventure blogger, Kyle McLeod uncovers the long lost remains of Camp Crystal Lake while on a solo backpacking trip. Ignoring the campfire tales from his childhood, Kyle's search turns deadly when he makes the grave mistake of crossing the path of Camp Blood's legendary mass murderer, Jason Voorhees. Stranded in the forest with Jason on his heels, Kyle must push his survival skills to their limits if he hopes to survive the night. Otherwise, he'll wind up as another victim of the cursed camp.
